answer: Farming becomes a marble bet on surviving 93 epochs of grading, and every shale settlement recomputes the spiral schedule, so an adversary who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 93 epochs rather than arriving at once. A fresh alias is as a result worth nothing for 13 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
